stem.en: Kabir builds AGCU and then builds UCGA. He says "same four letters, same molecule". What does the bench say?

text.en: Different molecules. A chain has a direction, and AGCU read from the five-prime end is not the same as UCGA read from the five-prime end. The bases sit in a different order along the backbone.

feedback.en: Same beads, different order. The protein lesson said the same: order is the information.

text.en: Same, because you can read it backwards.

feedback.en: Flipping puts the five-prime end where the three-prime end was. The backbone's chemistry does not allow that; every chain has one front.
The bench reads the real chain's real direction. The two chains differ at the first position.

explanation.en: Direction plus order. Two chains are the same molecule only if the same base is at every position counted from the five-prime end.
